title: Brotherly Treachery
summary: Betrayal is especially grievous when it comes from one who should have acted as brother, neighbor, or covenant ally.
background: Obadiah condemns Edom not only as an enemy but as a brother nation that stood aloof and rejoiced when Judah fell.
teachingHelp: Use this theme to teach covenant responsibility, mercy, and the sin of celebrating another person’s collapse.
